#3. 각 Ward별 중위값 변동 계산
MIN_COUNT = 10

start_period = df_hw[(df_hw['year'] >= 2006) & (df_hw['year'] <= 2011)]
start_counts = start_period.groupby('Ward').size()

valid_start_wards = start_counts[start_counts >= MIN_COUNT].index
start_period_valid = start_period[start_period['Ward'].isin(valid_start_wards)]
start_median = start_period_valid.groupby('Ward')['Price_per_Area'].median()
start_count_filtered = start_period_valid.groupby('Ward').size()


end_period = df_hw[(df_hw['year'] >= 2016) & (df_hw['year'] <= 2021)]
end_counts = end_period.groupby('Ward').size()
valid_end_wards = end_counts[end_counts >= MIN_COUNT].index
end_period_valid = end_period[end_period['Ward'].isin(valid_end_wards)]
end_median = end_period_valid.groupby('Ward')['Price_per_Area'].median()
end_count_filtered = end_period_valid.groupby('Ward').size()


valid_wards = start_median.index.intersection(end_median.index)
start_median = start_median.loc[valid_wards]
end_median = end_median.loc[valid_wards]

ward_prop = end_median / start_median
In [164]:
#4. 전체 중위값 변동 계산하기
overall_start_median = start_period['Price_per_Area'].median()
overall_end_median = end_period['Price_per_Area'].median()
overall_prop = overall_end_median / overall_start_median
In [166]:
#5. 결과 테이블 만들기
result = pd.DataFrame({
    'start_median': start_median,
    'start_count': start_count_filtered,
    'end_median': end_median,
    'end_count': end_count_filtered,
    'ward_prop': ward_prop
})

result['Gentrificated'] = result['ward_prop'] > overall_prop

df = df.merge(result[['Gentrificated']], left_on='Ward', right_index=True, how='left')

현재는 집값만 사용하여, 젠트리피케이션으로 식별된 곳이 많은데, 최종 학위/소득 기준을 확인할 수 있는 데이터를 넣어서 'and' 연산자 처리하면 조금 줄어들 긴 할듯 (예, 중위소득의 증가율과 중위집값의 증가율 둘다 전체와 비교하여 높아야 Gentrificated로 처리)

In [207]:
geometry = gpd.points_from_xy(df['longitude'], df['latitude'])
gdf = gpd.GeoDataFrame(df, geometry=geometry, crs="EPSG:4326")
gdf = gdf.to_crs(epsg=3857)

gdf['Gentrificated'] = gdf['Gentrificated'].fillna(False)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 10))
gdf[gdf['Gentrificated']].plot(ax=ax, color='red', markersize=1, alpha=0.5)
gdf[~gdf['Gentrificated']].plot(ax=ax, color='blue', markersize=1, alpha=0.5)

ctx.add_basemap(ax, source=ctx.providers.OpenStreetMap.Mapnik)

ax.set_title('London Gentrification Map (2010s vs 2020s); Red-Gentrificated', fontsize=14)

plt.axis('off')
plt.show()
